_doc: Compiler gravity rules (bible §64). Confidence is a §18 evidence class, not a probability.

rules.then: candidate native expert-gather (move only active experts, not the full inventory)
rules.reopen_if: active-byte reduction fails to move TPS because decode is kernel-bound not bandwidth-bound (A3B tps_caveat; Qwen3.8 same pattern)
rules.physical_rationale: O005: 8/128 experts/token, 3.353B active of 30.5B (11%). mlx specimen 29.3 TPS is ~dense — gather is the lever, not a smaller codec.
rules._evidence: INFERRED (A3B_RECON CLASSIFICATION.sparse_active_path = MOE-UNIVERSAL; census MEASURED on O005)

rules.then: cold-expert compression N/A; per-expert uniform codec is ok
rules.reopen_if: a patient shows cold experts, popularity skew, or entropy << max (then routing-frequency allocation may apply)
rules.physical_rationale: A3B entropy 6.09/7.00 bits, 0 never-routed, top expert 1.42% share, top-16 mass 18%. No skew to exploit.
rules._evidence: MEASURED (A3B_RECON route_map specimen, short prompt set; A1 still required for a full corpus)

rules.reopen_if: router ablation stays Doctor-stable after aggressive quant
rules.physical_rationale: bible §64 example. O005 router is 0.03 GB and gates all expert selection — cheap to keep precise, expensive if it is wrong.
rules._evidence: HYPOTHESIS (bible §64; O005 router bytes MEASURED, sensitivity UNKNOWN — A3)

rules.reopen_if: per-expert Doctor sensitivity is flat across the inventory
rules.physical_rationale: bible §64. Distinct from organ_inversion (gate vs down): this is expert-index heterogeneity inside the same organ.
rules._evidence: HYPOTHESIS (bible §64; O005 per-expert sensitivity UNKNOWN — A3)

rules.then: candidate prefetch of the next hot expert set
rules.reopen_if: transitions are near-uniform (A1 on O005 may confirm or kill)
rules.physical_rationale: bible §64 / §57. Frequency being uniform does not imply transitions are memoryless.

conditions: mlp1 gate+up more Doctor-sensitive than mlp2 down
rules.then: allocate bits to gate/up first, spend slack on down
rules.reopen_if: a parent measures NO organ sensitivity split (gate and down degrade within 10 percent of each other)
rules.physical_rationale: Foundry V1/V2 organ_inversion: F0 gpt-oss-120b real forward; F1 qwen3-235b dominant_failure_organ=gate.
rules._evidence: INFERRED (GRAVITY_METHOD_REGISTRY organ_inversion; not yet measured on Odyssey patients)

conditions: calibration corpus disjoint from scored holdout
rules.then: allocate rate by measured expert routing frequency
rules.reopen_if: near-uniform routing (then this rule is N/A — see R-uniform-routing-no-cold-compress). Never reopen the 88-token calibration.
rules.physical_rationale: Foundry prior is alive, but 88-token calibration is dead (median split 63.6% stable, 26.1% of cells never route). O005 specimen is near-uniform so this rule is currently negative on O005.
rules._evidence: HYPOTHESIS (registry alive; atlas killed 88-token calibration; O005 specimen argues N/A)

conditions: layer-0 non-Gaussianity or Shannon-gap >> mid/late layers
rules.then: do not treat all layers as one coding problem; per-layer codec selector
rules.reopen_if: patient measures flat layer-wise source statistics
rules.physical_rationale: qwen3-235b layer 0 is a different source. post_attention_layernorm gamma^2 anisotropy predicts it data-free.

rules.reopen_if: Doctor-valid q2 without a native kernel (foreign-runtime gate) or a native kernel that is not Doctor-valid
rules.physical_rationale: bible §64 example. Wrapper TPS is not a Hawking win (§60 foreign-runtime).
